source_title: CRSP US Stock & Indexes Database Guide File Format 2.0 (CIZ)
source_summary: DlyCap is market capitalization using daily closing trade price or bid/ask average times shares outstanding in thousands; PERMNO is security-level.

limitations: Security-level DlyCap is not an issuer-level denominator.
